text:
aria_sales: Heads-up — OrbitHealth wants a compliance proofpack to unblock their PO. Need list: redacted SOC2 control matrix excerpt, signed pentest attestation for our staging cluster addressed to their security team, and a quick delta estimate for delivering an on-prem VM image vs hosted POC. Can we ship these by Friday? @sam_se @julia_compliance @ben_security

sam_se: I can do the staging ops estimate. Quick clarifying q: do they require the pentest letter to call out IP ranges or is a scope description fine? Also, on-prem VM means we'll need a QA validation run and a signed helm/chart — extra ops time.

julia_compliance: For SOC2: we can extract the control matrix section and the scope page. We'll need to redact internal identifiers and remove employee names. ETA 1 business day to prepare redacted PDFs.

ben_security: For pen-test attestation: we can provide a signed letter confirming a third-party assessment of the isolated staging environment. We won't include vuln details or remediation steps. Legal will request Director sign-off and may prefer a generic scope description rather than IPs.

aria_sales: OrbitHealth's CISO (ramiro.h) asked that the letter be on company letterhead and addressed to them. They also asked whether their vendor can perform the test against our staging — they'd prefer to run their usual tester.

sam_se: If we permit their vendor: we require a short window (2-4 hours), a scoped CIDR whitelist, ephemeral creds via jumpbox, and an operations runbook to be executed. If they want on-prem image instead, one-time packaging + validation ~ $10-15k depending on image format; ongoing support ~$1.8k/mo. I'll provide a crisp number by EOD.

julia_compliance: Allowing external pentesters requires an NDA addendum and a short legal POA. That typically adds 2 business days. We must explicitly prohibit exploitation of any customer data and production peering.

ben_security: Also we'll require that any external tester upload their raw findings to our presigned S3 (read-only) and that they destroy creds after the window. No persistent agents. I'll spin up a draft pen-test attestation now.

ops_bot: Ticket created: EVID-2934 "OrbitHealth proofpack" with checklist: SOC2 excerpt, pentest attestation, NDA addendum, network isolation diagram. Assigned to aria_sales.

aria_sales: Great. Orbit wants a lightweight network diagram showing the staging isolation. Sam — can you paste an ASCII diagram or bullet points we can include?

sam_se: Sure — minimal diagram below:

```
Internet -> Load Balancer (ingress only) -> Staging Jumpbox (bastion) -> Isolated Staging Cluster
No peering with production VPC. Management plane on separate subnet.
```

aria_sales: Perfect. Julia — when SOC2 excerpt is ready, drop the S3 link here. Ben — when you have the draft, ping Legal and paste version for quick review.

julia_compliance: Will post redacted PDFs by tomorrow noon.

ben_security: Drafting attestation now. Will hand off to Legal for sign-off by 17:00 PT if all goes well.

sam_se: Sending the ballpark numbers to aria now: packaging + validation $13k one-time, remote pentest coordination $1.5k, monthly support $2k. Finalize EOD.

aria_sales: Thanks team — I'll tell OrbitHealth procurement the nonblocking estimate and loop back once the artifacts are ready. :thumbsup:
